claim: For the KNY 2017 sec.8.2.19 PIII(D_6) base-point configuration P_{12} + P_{34} + P_{5678} (KNY eq 8.98), each of the seven canonical KNY simple roots delta_0, ..., delta_6 (KNY eq 8.101) is classified as one of: 'effective' (admits a non-negative integer decomposition into irreducible components of the configuration: the 7 D_6^{(1)} (-2)-curves themselves plus 3 (-1)-curve chain-tip exceptional divisors E_2, E_4, E_8) / 'not_effective' (no such decomposition exists) / 'effective_after_named_Weyl_move' (becomes effective after a single Weyl reflection through one of the other six delta_j, with the move and post-reflection decomposition recorded). The classification is determined by integer linear-algebra: since the 10 irreducible components form a Z-basis of Pic(X) (verified by unimodular determinant), each Pic class has a unique integer decomposition and effectivity reduces to non-negativity of coefficients. When `effective`, the explicit decomposition is recorded.

pre_registered_verdict_per_delta_i_based.delta_3_reasoning: strict transform of the H_2 ruling fiber through P_5 with P_6 infinitely near.
pre_registered_verdict_per_delta_i_based.delta_4_reasoning: strict transform of E_6 after blowing up P_7 on it; chain {5,6,7,8}.
pre_registered_verdict_per_delta_i_based.delta_5_reasoning: strict transform of E_5 after blowing up P_6 on it; chain {5,6,7,8}.
pre_registered_verdict_per_delta_i_based.delta_6_reasoning: strict transform of E_7 after blowing up P_8 on it; end of chain {5,6,7,8}.

deviation_from_synthesizer_table.resolution: synthesizer flagged this contingency explicitly: 'the agent should verify the exact delta_i from d6_affine_simple_roots_kny() and update the pre-registered table accordingly. If any delta_i has a form not on this list, declare the expected verdict based on its actual form before computing.' Following that instruction; the synthesizer's reconstructed delta_4 = H_1 - E_5 - E_7 would not satisfy the D_6^{(1)} affine marks identity (sum a_i delta_i = -K_X) under the canonical (1,1,2,2,2,1,1) marks already verified in cycle 2. The actual source delta_4 = E_6 - E_7 does satisfy that identity (verified in cycle 2's test_kny_imaginary_root_equals_anti_canonical). No anomaly; this is the same per-deliverable verification the synthesizer flagged as expected.

actual_decompositions_summary: each delta_i decomposes trivially as itself with multiplicity 1; the seven delta_i are the (-2)-component half of the 10-component Z-basis of Pic(X).
